Hi Emily — quick security checklist from our side to avoid back-and-forth later:

Required items before we enable Private/VPC POC:
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted excerpt is ok).
- Network/data flow diagram showing where tokens/data originate and egress points.
- KMS integration requirements (do you require HSM/KMS on your side, or will you use Redwood-managed envelope keys while we run the POC?).
- Approved IP ranges for peering and an expected volume (to size capacity).
- Confirmation of any export-control/data residency constraints.

Optional but helpful:
- Recent pen-test summary (redacted).
- Sample prompts/data classification notes if you want us to pre-configure filtering/caching rules.

Once we have the SOC2 + network diagram we can run a short secure connectivity test (VPN/PrivateLink) before enabling customer-managed KMS or dedicated peering.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
